article.title: Instagram Edits推出Mac版，跨手機專案編輯仍待完成
article.title_en: Instagram Edits reaches Mac while cross-device project editing remains planned
article.summary: 11月6日直接報道引述官方公布，桌面版加入多軌剪輯及品牌字型匯入。
article.summary_en: A November 6 direct report cites Instagram’s announcement of multitrack desktop editing and brand-font imports.
highlights: macOS版提供多軌時間線及關鍵影格。
手機儲存的部分樣式可沿用，完整跨端專案編輯仍在開發。
highlights_en: The macOS version offers a multitrack timeline and keyframes.
Some saved mobile styles carry over; seamless cross-device project editing is still in development.
article.why: 短片團隊可評估在較大畫面完成精細剪輯，以及直接銜接Instagram發布的流程。
article.why_en: Short-video teams can assess precision desktop editing and a direct Instagram publishing workflow.
article.next_step: 先用非機密測試片核對字型、字幕與輸出；商用音樂逐首查授權。
article.next_step_en: Check fonts, captions and exports with a non-confidential test clip; verify music rights individually.
article.detail: 官方文章在本輪未能直接讀取，這篇採用Net Influencer對同一公布的完整直接報道，並保留來源限制。報道把macOS桌面版與未完成的跨端專案編輯分開，不能把部分樣式同步寫成專案已可任意切換裝置。團隊亦應另查音樂商用權、外掛及帳戶支援。編輯沒有進行產品試用，功能描述均按報道所引述的公司說法歸因。
article.detail_en: The official post could not be read directly, so this story uses the full dated direct report with that limitation. Style carryover does not establish seamless project transfer. Check commercial music rights and account support separately; no product test was performed.
